slides.texte_overlay:
6 habits that quietly make
a man magnetic
1. He keeps his promises, even small ones. Showing up when he said he would makes people trust him without thinking.
2. He has stories, not just opinions. Real experiences from travel, work and hobbies make him fascinating to listen to.
3. He's comfortable with silence. He doesn't rush to fill pauses. That calm makes people feel at ease around him.
4. He gives sincere compliments. Specific, honest, without wanting anything back. People remember how he made them feel.
5. He never stops learning. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and curiosity is what keeps conversations alive.
slides.texte_sophia: 5. I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Curiosity is what keeps conversations alive.

slides.texte_overlay: 6. He takes care of himself. Training, grooming, sleep. Self-respect is quietly attractive to everyone around him.
Magnetism isn't a trick. It's a collection of small good habits, repeated every day. Start with one of them this week and build from there.
